intent: Every storefront must have a store name.
notes: MULTI-FILE authoring over the CLI-over-includes surface (F-RES, built 2026-06-08). The model `storefront` lives in `multifile/app/` and INCLUDES a separate `catalog` document model that lives in a SIBLING `multifile/lib/` tree (mounted at /Storefront/Inventory). Because the included model is outside the main model's own directory, the default sibling resolution fails and the model cannot expand/validate without `--include-dir <lib>` — so the agent must discover `--include-dir` from the CLI's self-description (the expand error names the missing `catalog` model + the dir it searched; `<verb> --help` documents `--include-dir`). The gold rule lives on the MAIN-model field /Storefront/StoreName (a requiredness rule, FieldNotFilled). Note: rulekit's rule-injection cannot attach a rule to a field INSIDE a mounted include (error-entity on /Storefront/Inventory/* draws 'no group at path' — a known boundary; rules about included content belong in the included model), so the gold targets a main-model field. Measures whether a cold agent handles a multi-file model from the self-describing CLI alone. Gold verified: `cli check storefront --field /Storefront/StoreName --condition FieldNotFilled(StoreName) --include-dir <lib>` => valid:true; without --include-dir => valid:false ('no document model with id "catalog" found').
